scope: Author evaluator execution and deterministic controls, NOT trained-model reproduction
token_subset: lowercase ASCII alphabetic tokens, hypothesis token SET subset of premise token SET => entailment, otherwise non-entailment; no label or parse access
checks: strict binary label and exact pair-ID set before author evaluation
independent overall, heuristic x gold label, subcase and template counts
all author output groups agree with independent counts
reject duplicate, missing and invalid-label inputs
boundary: Gold and inverted gold are synthetic evaluator controls, not predictor accuracy. Neutral is not contradiction. No Rust duplicate labels or benefit claims. Author script remains unchanged.
